meta_description:
Gen Z style icon Matilda Djerf is the queen of laid-back style that serves 10/10 timelessness, whilst still feeling perfectly of the moment. Capturing the essence of Scandi cool in a way that feels achievable for all, Ms Djerf's wardrobe has us in a serious chokehold. If you're feeling similarly inspired to channel the best parts of Matilda's cold weather styling, head to the Zoella website for a rundown of her best winter looks, and where to shop to recreate them for yourself! [link in Stories and bio]

Follow Matilda here - @matildadjerf 😻 - @zoella on December 14, 2022
